name: When is it better to replace a sliding door rather than just repair the track?

mainEntity.name: When is it better to replace a sliding door rather than just repair the track?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing a sliding door entirely might be more cost-effective than just repairing the track if the door frame itself is severely damaged, the door panels are warped, or the insulation and energy efficiency are significantly compromised. If the door is old, and parts are obsolete, a full replacement can offer better long-term performance, security, and aesthetic appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacing the entire door if the frame is severely damaged, panels are warped, or insulation is compromised. A new door offers better long-term performance.
